build_trajectory_dict_from_observations: build a trajectory dictionary from a list of robot observation dicts with optional scaling and image inclusion
downsample_trajectory_dict: downsample a trajectory dictionary from high-frequency simulation timesteps to a coarser time step
plot_robot_trajectories: plot multiple robot trajectory quantities as subplots with optional timestamp markers and save to file
compute_per_finger_position_error: compute the per-finger L2 distance between predicted and ground truth fingertip positions
compute_reach_scaled_error: compute the average scaled reach error for a list of fingers relative to a cube object
